2.211.17
MapColorScale.RangeGapColor
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapColorScale.RangeGapColor element specifies the color to be used in a MapColorScale to fill
the undefined color divisions. This element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be an
RdlColor or an expression that evaluates to an RdlColor. If this element is not present, its value is
interpreted as "White".
The following is the parent element of the MapColorScale.RangeGapColor element.
Parent elements
MapColorScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapColorScale.RangeGapColor element.
 <xsd:element name="RangeGapColor" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
